schema.name: cgt-figure-manifest
schema.description: Machine-readable manifest for the checksum-pinned CGT website figure release, including the audited Figure 1, Figure 2, and Figure 3 revisions and their downloads.

interpretation: minor_polish is the release curation state; it does not mean that every publisher-specific typography check passed.

Figures 1–3 are core main candidates; Figure 4 is synthesis/supporting material suitable for main or supplementary placement; Figure 5 is supporting material suitable for supplementary placement or a compact main panel.

recovery_capture.purpose: Authoritative file-level hashes used for local integrity verification.

qa_summary.figure_01: Audited at design, web-export, and 600-dpi resolution: zero out-of-canvas text objects, text–text overlaps, workflow-box containment violations, protected statistics–legend overlaps, or legend-occluded observations; minimum workflow-text clearance is 2.002 pt and statistics–legend separation is 12.762 pt.
qa_summary.figure_02: Exact 182.88 × 190.50 mm canvas; 4,320 × 4,500 publication PNG at 600 dpi; 2,400 × 2,500 web PNG; 7.0 pt minimum font; no canvas/container escape, text collision, legend/data collision, clipping, invalid SVG, unembedded PDF font, numerical mismatch, or cross-format failure; complete human visual review passed. The two-column composite is uncropped at 480 px, but small publication text requires an open-original or zoom affordance on narrow screens unless a separately approved mobile derivative is supplied.
qa_summary.figure_03: Exact 183 × 204 mm canvas; 4,323 × 4,819 publication PNG at 599.9988 dpi; 2,400 × 2,675 web PNG at 96.012 dpi; 7.0 pt minimum font; pinned ICC profile; path-text SVG; embedded TrueType PDF; zero geometry, collision, external-dependency, numerical, or cross-format failures; 392 byte-identical files across two clean renders; complete hash-anchored human visual review passed. The composite remains uncropped at 480 px, but its fine text is zoom-dependent and is not claimed to be comfortably readable at native narrow-screen size.
qa_summary.figure_04: Minimum text size 4.50 pt is below target; three clipping diagnostics were recorded.
qa_summary.figure_05: A text audit exists, but no Nature-compliance report was found.

exclusions.reason: Exploratory prototype material, not part of the frozen canonical figure set.

caveats: This manifest records the selected release and its provenance; it does not itself establish peer review, reproducibility outside the captured environment, or causal validity.

Figures 1, 2, and 3 are checksum-pinned audited replacement releases with their recorded revision scopes. Figures 4–5 and the supplements retain their prior freeze states and publisher-specific issues documented in qa_summary and per-figure QA.
The recovery bundle verifies capture integrity but is candidate/unreviewed and explicitly does not establish a CORD result.
CGT topography assets were excluded because the freeze report classifies them as exploratory.
Scientific interpretation must preserve the claim boundaries recorded in the associated legends, methods, source data, notebooks, and claim ledger.

caveats: The result supports predictive association within the represented data regime rather than universal transfer or causality.
Regression and thresholded classification are two views of the same external GeneEffect source, not independent biological confirmations.

The downloadable Figure 1 package does not by itself establish that the complete historical analysis is reproducible from source.

caveats: The figure establishes descriptive, preprocessing-dependent associations inside the CGT family-coordinate pipeline. It does not establish an identified causal effect, a mechanistic cellular law, external phenotype prediction, or family universality.

Residual baselines were estimated once from the full PREDICT-003B table before holdout splitting rather than re-estimated inside each training fold; panels e/f therefore evaluate transfer conditional on transductive preprocessing, not a fully nested inductive pipeline.
The “same-study” exclusion is only a dataset-name-prefix proxy, not verified study identity.

Cluster-bootstrap intervals use only 4–34 held-out clusters depending on scheme/design and quantify resampling variability under that clustering choice; they do not establish mechanistic, causal, or biological universality.

evidence_dependence.ora_and_rank: Dependent summaries that reuse the same coordinates and overlapping gene-set memberships.
evidence_dependence.ridge_and_spearman: Dependent summaries that reuse the same essentiality_strength = −mean DepMap GeneEffect endpoint and overlapping genes.
evidence_dependence.panels: Panels d and e are representative evidence views and panel f is a robustness boundary; none is an independent replication of another panel.

caveats: A local SVD mode is a dataset-specific latent direction, and residual sign denotes below- or above-context-mean absolute family mass rather than intrinsic negative or positive biology.
Candidate annotations are manually curated, post hoc shorthands rather than latent-mode identities, measured quantities, mechanisms, or constraint laws.
Explicit sign filtering removes the invalid F1, F3, and F15 upper views; boundary ties make corrected realized query sizes range from 20 to 362.

Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment is separate for ORA and rank across all 201,771 corrected view–term tests per method; displayed terms are illustrative, manually selected representatives rather than exhaustive results.
The pooled background contains 1,229 genes, while high-confidence absolute views use their eligible 255-gene universe for both ORA and rank analysis.
Matrix values are descriptive maxima; NR is no retained result rather than zero, and within-column shading neither makes unlike metrics commensurate nor defines a combined evidence score.
ORA and rank are dependent, and RidgeCV and Spearman summaries share the same GeneEffect-derived endpoint and overlapping genes; no displayed evidence channel is an independent replication.

The 16 closed residual features have matrix rank 12; F15 = 0.19354839 × F3, F6 = −F5, and F4 and F13 are zero, so ridge coefficients are coding- and penalty-dependent descriptive estimates without uncertainty intervals.
All 41 F14 lower-query genes have the CuiHacohen2023 study proxy, so the cytokine result is study-conditioned rather than a general or transportable F14 biological axis.
F3 and F15 are scaled copies, not independent discoveries, and 35 of 40 high-confidence query genes have a LaraAstiasoHuntly2023 study proxy.

The F12 absolute query is 40/40 and the F12 lower query is 30/30 ReplogleWeissman2022 K562; leave-study-out reconstruction, study-matched nulls, independent-study recurrence, a declared contrast basis, and study-block bootstrap uncertainty remain required.

The figure supports descriptive, study-conditioned pathway coherence in manually curated, associative, pipeline-dependent summaries; it does not identify a validated pathway, general biological program, mechanism, universal axis, causal module, universal constraint, or causal law.
